newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 27.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 27.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker suppliers maintained their recent offer levels on Thursday while shipowners stayed on the sidelines awaiting fresh movements in the cargo market, traders said. With the firm cargo market, traders did not expect a drop in bunker prices although shipowners were still unwilling to raise their bids.
